skill.negation: Hateten lae ho 안 no 못
skill.culture_deep: Deep Korean cultural values and customs

yvowels.title: Vogál Y
yvowels.concept: Tau liña badak ida halo lian **y**: ㅏ → ㅑ (ya), ㅓ → ㅕ (yeo), ㅗ → ㅛ (yo), ㅜ → ㅠ (yu). ㅐ (ae) no ㅔ (e) iha Koreanu modernu lian hanesan tebes.

consonants2.title: Konsoante tan
consonants2.concept: ㄹ mak lian entre “r” no “l”. ㅈ (j), ㅊ (ch, ho anin sai), ㅋ (k, ho anin sai), ㅌ (t, ho anin sai) no ㅍ (p, ho anin sai) kompleta konsoante bázika sira.

doubled.title: Konsoante dobradu
doubled.concept: ㄲ, ㄸ, ㅃ, ㅆ no ㅉ mak lian tensu: hatete ho kakorok kesi no la iha anin sai, hanesan lian dahuluk iha “skate”.

batchim.title: Konsoante final
batchim.concept: Konsoante ne'ebé hela iha sílaba okos bolu **받침 (batchim)**. Nia taka sílaba: 안 (an), 말 (mal), 밤 (bam), 강 (gang), 집 (jip), 책 (chaek). Iha ikus bele iha lian hitu de'it: ㄱ ㄴ ㄷ ㄹ ㅁ ㅂ ㅇ.

words2.title: Liafuan loroloron
words2.concept: Lee liafuan ida-idak sílaba ida-idak. 학교 lee “hakgyo”: ㄱ final husi 학 taka no sílaba tuir mai hatete ho kesi.

words3.title: Liafuan kona-ba mundu
words3.concept: Ema no natureza: 사람 (ema), 나라 (nasaun), 하늘 (lalehan), 산 (foho), 강 (ribeira), 꽃 (funan).

manners.title: Espresaun ho respeitu
manners.concept: Uza 실례합니다 atu foti ema nia atensaun ka liu, 고마워요 atu hato'o obrigadu ho belun, 천만에요 atu hatán obrigadu, no 축하해요 atu fó parabéns.

introduce.title: Naran no nasaun
introduce.concept: Husu naran ho 이름이 뭐예요? no nasaun ho 어느 나라 사람이에요? Hatán ho 제 이름은 ___예요 ka 저는 ___ 사람이에요.

partings.title: Hateten adeus
partings.concept: Entre belun bele dehan 잘 가요 (adeus), 내일 봐요 (to'o aban), 또 만나요 (to'o fali) no 잘 자요 (toba di'ak).

wellbeing.title: Ita di'ak ka lae?
wellbeing.concept: Husu 잘 지냈어요? (Ita di'ak ka lae?) no hatán 잘 지내요 (Ha'u di'ak). 좋은 아침이에요 signifika “Dader di'ak ida.”

helpme.title: Husu ajuda
helpme.concept: Dehan 도와주세요 atu husu ajuda, 모르겠어요 bainhira la hatene, 알겠어요 bainhira komprende, no 다시 말해 주세요 atu husu ema hatete fali.

opinions.title: Gosta no resposta
opinions.concept: 좋아요 signifika di'ak ka diak, 싫어요 signifika la gosta, 맞아요 signifika “loos” no 틀려요 signifika “sala”.

native10.title: Númeru koreanu nian 6–10
native10.concept: Kontinua númeru koreanu nian: 여섯 (6), 일곱 (7), 여덟 (8), 아홉 (9), 열 (10).

sino.title: Númeru sino-koreanu
sino.concept: Númeru sino-koreanu: 일 (1), 이 (2), 삼 (3), 사 (4), 오 (5), 육 (6), 칠 (7), 팔 (8), 구 (9), 십 (10). Uza ba osan, data, númeru telefone no minutu.

ages.title: Idade
ages.concept: Husu 몇 살이에요? (Ita nia idade hira?). Idade uza númeru koreanu nian ho 살: 열 살 (tinan 10), 스무 살 (20), 서른 살 (30).

family2.title: Liafuan família tan
family2.concept: Liafuan ba alin-maun sira muda tuir ema ne'ebé koalia: feto ida dehan 오빠 (maun) no 언니 (biin). Mós 아들 (oan-mane), 딸 (oan-feto), 부모님 (inan-aman).

ourfamily.title: Ami-nia família
ourfamily.concept: Koreanu sira dala barak dehan 우리 (ami, ita-nia) troka “ha'u-nia”: 우리 가족 signifika “ha'u-nia família”. Sura ema ho 명: 네 명 (ema na'in haat).

food.title: Hahán no hemu
food.concept: 밥 (etu, hahán), 빵 (paun), 과일 (fuan-ai), 고기 (naan), 물 (bee), 우유 (susubeen).

likes.title: Gosta no la gosta
likes.concept: Dehan buat ne'ebé ita gosta ho -를/을 좋아해요 no buat ne'ebé ita la gosta ho -를/을 싫어해요: 저는 사과를 좋아해요.

adjectives.title: Deskreve buat sira
adjectives.concept: Liafuan deskrisaun mós remata ho -요: 커요 (boot), 작아요 (ki'ik), 많아요 (barak), 맛있어요 (gostu), 예뻐요 (bonita).

weather.title: Klima
weather.concept: 날씨 (klima), 더워요 (manas), 추워요 (malirin), 비가 와요 (udan monu), 눈이 와요 (neve monu).

negation.title: Hateten lae ho 안 no 못
negation.concept: Tau **안** molok verbu atu dehan ita la halo buat ida (안 가요). Tau **못** molok nia atu dehan ita labele (못 가요).

daily.title: Atividade loroloron
daily.concept: 일어나요 (hamriik), 씻어요 (hariis), 일해요 (serbisu), 자요 (toba). Liafuan tempu hanesan 아침 (dader) no 밤 (kalan) simu 에: 아침에.

weekdays.title: Loron semana nian
weekdays.concept: 월요일 (Segunda), 화요일 (Tersa), 수요일 (Kuarta), 목요일 (Kinta), 금요일 (Sesta), 토요일 (Sabadu), 일요일 (Domingu).

months.title: Fulan sira
months.concept: Fulan mak númeru sino-koreanu mais 월: 일월 (Janeiru), 삼월 (Marsu), 오월 (Maiu), 칠월 (Jullu), 구월 (Setembru), 십이월 (Dezembru).

clock.title: Dehan oras
clock.concept: Oras uza númeru koreanu nian mais 시: 한 시 (1:00), 두 시 (2:00), 세 시 (3:00), 열 시 (10:00). Husu 몇 시예요?

frequency.title: Dala hira
frequency.concept: 매일 (loron-loron), 자주 (dala barak), 가끔 (dala ruma), 항상 (nafatin). Tau sira molok verbu.

past2.title: Tempu pasadu tan
past2.concept: Final tempu pasadu mak -았/었어요: 했어요 (halo ona), 왔어요 (mai ona), 만났어요 (hasoru ona), 샀어요 (sosa ona), 잤어요 (toba ona).

birthday.title: Aniversáriu no fim-de-semana
birthday.concept: 생일 (aniversáriu), 주말 (fim-de-semana), 선물 (prezente). Husu 생일이 언제예요? no hatán 제 생일은 오월이에요.

restaurant.title: Iha restaurante
restaurant.concept: 메뉴 (menu), 주문할게요 (ha'u sei husu), 물 더 주세요 (favór fó bee tan), 계산해 주세요 (favór konta).

transport.title: Viaja
transport.concept: 버스 (otobus), 지하철 (metro), 택시 (taxi), 기차 (komboiu). Dehan oinsá ita bá ho -로/으로: 버스로 가요.

phone.title: Telefone no mensajen
phone.concept: 전화 (telefone), 전화번호 (númeru telefone), 문자 (mensajen). 전화해요 signifika “ha'u telefone”.

hospital.title: Iha hospitál
hospital.concept: 병원 (hospitál), 약 (aimoruk), 아파요 (moras). Dehan parte isin uluk: 머리가 아파요 (ulun moras).

requests.title: Husu ho respeitu
requests.concept: -세요 no -아/어 주세요 halo pedidu ho respeitu: 앉으세요 (favór tuur), 기다려 주세요 (favór hein), 문을 열어 주세요 (favór loke odamatan).

invitations.title: Halo planu hamutuk
invitations.concept: 같이 (hamutuk) konvida ema: 같이 가요. 갈래요? husu “Ita hakarak bá ka lae?” no 시간 있어요? husu “Ita iha tempu ka lae?”

indirect_state.title: Indirect statements (-다고 하다)
indirect_state.concept: Report what someone says or said: verb/adj + -다고 하다.

indirect_cmd.title: Indirect commands and suggestions (-라고 / -자고 하다)
indirect_cmd.concept: Report an imperative (-라고 하다) or propositive (-자고 하다).

cause_contrast.title: Complex causes and contrasts (-느라고, -는데도)
cause_contrast.concept: Negative cause or delay (-느라고) and contrast despite circumstances (-는데도).

proportion.title: Proportion and inevitability (-을수록, -기 마련이다)
proportion.concept: The more... the more (-을수록) and natural inevitability (-기 마련이다).

appearance.title: Appearance and inference (-아/어 보이다, -는 모양이다)
appearance.concept: Looks like (-아/어 보이다) and appears to be (-는 모양이다).

pretense.title: Pretending (-는 척하다)
pretense.concept: Pretend to do or be something: -(으)ㄴ/는 척하다.

regret.title: Regret and counterfactuals (-(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요)
regret.concept: Express regret: 'I should have done...' -(으)ㄹ 걸 그랬어요.

review_k7.title: K7 Comprehensive Review
review_k7.concept: Review indirect speech, complex connectors and nuanced expressions.

honorific_subj.title: Honorific vocabulary for subjects
honorific_subj.concept: Special honorific nouns and verbs for revered people: 진지, 주무시다, 편찮으시다.

honorific_obj.title: Object honorific verbs (드리다, 뵙다, 여쭙다)
honorific_obj.concept: Humble/honorific verbs when the action is directed toward an elder: 드리다, 뵙다, 여쭙다.

passive_affix.title: Affix passives (-이/히/리/기-)
passive_affix.concept: Passive verbs formed by adding -이/히/리/기-: 보이다, 들리다, 열리다, 닫히다.

passive_compound.title: Syntactic passives (-어지다, -게 되다)
passive_compound.concept: Verbs taking spontaneous or resulting passive forms: -아/어지다, -게 되다.

causative_affix.title: Affix causatives (-이/히/리/기/우-)
causative_affix.concept: Causative verbs that make someone do an action: 보여 주다, 먹이다, 입히다.

causative_compound.title: Syntactic causatives (-게 하다)
causative_compound.concept: Make or cause someone to do something: -게 하다.

formal_style.title: Public formal style (-하십시오)
formal_style.concept: High formal deferential style for announcements and ceremonies: -하십시오, -하십시다.

modesty.title: Modest and humble expressions
modesty.concept: Polite speech using humble pronouns and verbs: 저희, 말씀 올리다.

review_k8.title: K8 Comprehensive Review
review_k8.concept: Review honorifics, passive, causative and formal polite registers.

biz_email.title: Business email writing and requests
biz_email.concept: Formal business email conventions: -에 관하여, 검토 부탁드립니다.

biz_phone.title: Business telephone etiquette
biz_phone.concept: Handling calls and messages: 통화 가능하신지요, 연결해 드리겠습니다.

biz_schedule.title: Scheduling and rescheduling
biz_schedule.concept: Proposing and changing appointment times: 변경하고자 합니다, 양해 부탁드립니다.

biz_meeting.title: Meeting discussions and opinions
biz_meeting.concept: Expressing views during meetings: 제 생각으로는, 찬성합니다, 추가 검토.

biz_report.title: Reporting project progress
biz_report.concept: Giving status updates: 진행 상황을 보고합니다, 조치를 완료했습니다.

biz_stats.title: Statistical figures and data trends
biz_stats.concept: Describing trends and numbers: 증가했습니다, 전년 대비.

biz_negotiate.title: Business negotiations and partnerships
biz_negotiate.concept: Professional collaboration: 상호 협력을 희망합니다, 절충안 제시.

biz_etiquette.title: Business cards and professional titles
biz_etiquette.concept: Exchanging cards and titles: 처음 뵙겠습니다, 명함 드립니다.

review_k9.title: K9 Comprehensive Review
review_k9.concept: Review professional communications, formal correspondence and meetings.

media_headline.title: Headlines and compressed style
media_headline.concept: News headlines and compressed noun phrases: 물가 안정 대책 발표.

media_article.title: Current affairs and editorials
media_article.concept: Reading short news articles: 친환경 에너지가 주목받고 있습니다.

idioms_body.title: Body-part idioms (발, 눈, 귀, 손)
idioms_body.concept: Common idioms with body parts: 발이 넓다 (wide network), 눈이 높다 (high standards).

idioms_action.title: Everyday action idioms (바가지, 어깨)
idioms_action.concept: Expressions for common situations: 바가지를 쓰다 (ripped off), 어깨가 무겁다 (heavy duty).

proverbs_life.title: Essential Korean proverbs
proverbs_life.concept: Wisdom in proverbs: 소 잃고 외양간 고친다, 쇠뿔도 단김에 빼라.

sino_four.title: Four-character idioms (사자성어)
sino_four.concept: Common four-character Chinese-derived idioms: 일석이조, 작심삼일, 다다익선.

logic_debate.title: Logical connectors and discourse markers
logic_debate.concept: Formal discourse markers: -에 따르면, 한편, 요컨대, 따라서.

culture_deep.title: Deep Korean cultural values and customs
culture_deep.concept: Cultural concepts and holiday traditions: 따뜻한 정, 송편을 빚다.

review_k10.title: K10 Comprehensive Review
review_k10.concept: Mastery of Korean culture, media, idioms and formal debate expressions.

note.native: Númeru koreanu nian (하나, 둘, 셋 …) uza atu sura buat sira no ba oras.
